verdict.rationale: Tailscale's own docs describe subnet routers as a feature that gives devices outside the local network access to services within specific subnets, extending the private network. That is the core of this story. The evidence is only KB summary lines, with no setup or routing detail, and community reports praise remote access generally without confirming subnet routing specifically. Missing for 10: in-depth subnet router documentation (route advertisement, approval, access control), independent hands-on corroboration of subnet routing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use subnet routers to reach devices outside my local network as if I were on it

citations.quote: Use subnet routers to give devices outside your local network access to services within specific subnets.
